title: Eastern Governorate Completes Universal Access Projects in Early 2021
summary: The Eastern Governorate of Saudi Arabia announced the completion of universal access projects in early 2021, focusing on infrastructure that supports individuals with disabilities.
body:
The Eastern Governorate of Saudi Arabia announced the completion of universal access projects in early 2021, focusing on infrastructure that supports individuals with disabilities.
